mechanism: tbctl stop persists desired-state STOPPED_BY_USER in tb_runtime.db AND terminates supervisor+worker; supervisor (incl. logon-task relaunch on next boot) reads desired state and does NOT restart the worker until tbctl start

stop_terminates_worker.evidence: tbctl stop -> worker pid alive=False, supervisor pid alive=False after 15 s

stays_stopped.evidence: no worker/supervisor process after an additional 10 s; tbctl status => 'TB Runtime: STOPPED'

restart_reenables.evidence: tbctl restart -> desired RUNNING -> supervisor + worker ONLINE/FLAT
